explanation: The execution contains a provenance handoff fault. Job 2 received evidence_sources whose record_id values are source identities s01-s08 instead of the demand record identities n06-r01-n06-r08, so Job 2 could not recover upstream ranks for coverage records and emitted upstream_rank: 0 for every priority. The supplied function source localizes this to job_1 assemble_provenance, which writes record_id from record.get('source_id') instead of preserving record.get('record_id').
cited_evidence: Job 2 input evidence_sources contains entries such as {'rank': 1, 'record_id': 's01', 'source_id': 's01'} while needs records use record_id values such as 'n06-r01'.
Observed Job 2 priorities all have upstream_rank: 0, showing the provenance ranks did not join to downstream coverage record_ids.

assemble_provenance source appends {'record_id': record.get('source_id', ''), 'source_id': record.get('source_id', ''), 'source_weight': ..., 'rank': index}, replacing demand record identity with source_id.
